name: Companion Card
shortDescription: A card for eligible South Australians with significant and permanent disability that provides free entry for a companion or carer at participating venues and activities.
plainEnglishSummary: If you have a significant and permanent disability and need lifelong attendant care to participate in community activities, a Companion Card may allow your companion or carer to enter participating venues with you at no charge.
audience: South Australians with a severe or profound lifelong disability
People who cannot participate at most venues and activities without significant attendant care
People requiring substantial assistance with mobility, communication, self-care or planning
supportTypes: Free companion admission at participating venues
Free companion access to participating activities
Free Master Locksmiths Access Key for cardholders
availabilityNote: The cardholder purchases their own ticket and the participating venue provides a companion ticket at no charge. The card is lifelong and is generally renewed every 10 years so the holder's details and photograph can be updated. Venue participation and additional activity charges may vary.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility. Applicants generally need to live in South Australia or reside there under a valid visa, have a severe or profound lifelong disability, and require significant lifelong attendant care to participate at most community venues and activities. Having a disability or an NDIS plan does not automatically qualify someone for a Companion Card.
